description: Heat Score history from the public daily history. from is required (YYYY-MM-DD), to defaults to the last day. interval day|week|month|auto (auto picks the finest that fits 400 points); max_points (1-400) caps the points: auto uses 180 by default, and with max_points the latest points are kept and truncated is set. A summary covers the whole range.

max_points.description: Most points to return; older points are dropped and truncated is set

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: last available day)

name: get_history
title: Heat Score history
